answered.sql: SELECT activityName FROM Activities WHERE activityID IN (SELECT activityID FROM Resorts_Activities GROUP BY activityID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT resortID) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Resorts))

candidates.meaning: List the activities offered by every resort.
candidates.sql: SELECT r.name AS resort_name, a.activityName FROM Resorts r JOIN Resorts_Activities ra ON r.id = ra.resortID JOIN Activities a ON ra.activityID = a.activityID
